text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You're tell'n me you don't have any
pickled
plums?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Not really... I've got a real mean
headache, so I
wanted t'buy some
pickled plums...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Evidently, if you stick 'em to your head,
your
headache'll go away. It's an old folk
remedy...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Owww... I've gotta find some fast...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Yukino Bijin's headache is
stressing
her out.
